tse2020oct19time.title: Report on the Cash Equity Trading System Failure on Oct. 1
tse2020oct19time.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc.
tse2020oct19time.quote: At 7:04 a.m. JST on October 1, a large number of messages were detected showing some difficulties in accessing Device 1 of the Shared Disk Device [footnote marker omitted] (hereinafter referred to as "NAS"). [...] On confirming the situation with the system development vendor Fujitsu, at 7:55 a.m. we became aware that a memory module failure had caused the control unit of Device 1 to fail, and a failure of the automated switch to Device 2 had caused the whole NAS to become unavailable.
supports: 7:04 a.m. JST detection on 1 October 2020
Device 1 of the Shared Disk Device (NAS)
memory module failure killed the control unit
the automated switch to Device 2 did not happen
Fujitsu was the system development vendor

tse2020oct19spec.title: Report on the Cash Equity Trading System Failure on Oct. 1
tse2020oct19spec.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc.
tse2020oct19spec.quote: TSE has a system requirement that operations should continue in the case of a NAS failure by switching over to another device within 30 seconds. When we developed the current version of arrowhead, we discussed with Fujitsu what NAS setting would be appropriate with reference to the Fujitsu product manual. Since the product manual said the automatic switchover would function regardless of the NAS setting, we decided on the NAS setting taking into account the past performance of arrowhead with the same setting. This decision was also confirmed by Fujitsu. However, the investigation after the failure on October 1 revealed that with NAS at said setting, the current product specifications are such that the automatic switchover would not function in the case of a memory module failure. The deficiency in the product manual prevented a proper understanding of the product specifications.
supports: 30-second switchover requirement
the Fujitsu product manual said switchover would work regardless of the setting
the manual's deficiency hid the real product specification

tse2020oct19halt.title: Report on the Cash Equity Trading System Failure on Oct. 1
tse2020oct19halt.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc.
tse2020oct19halt.quote: Although we continued working to enable a switchover to Device 2, we were unable to guarantee a schedule for this to happen, and since the correct market data was not being disseminated, at 8:36 a.m. we decided to halt trading of all listed issues from market open (9:00 a.m.) and made an announcement to this effect. [...] Under normal operations, trading is halted using TSE's in-house trading control screens. However, this process requires access to NAS, so we decided to take an alternative approach to halt trading by shutting down the connection of the network connecting arrowhead and trading participants. This instruction was given at 8:54 a.m.
supports: 8:36 a.m. decision to halt all listed issues from the 9:00 a.m. open
the normal halt path itself needed the NAS
8:54 a.m. instruction to cut the network to trading participants

tse2020oct19switch.title: Report on the Cash Equity Trading System Failure on Oct. 1
tse2020oct19switch.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc.
tse2020oct19switch.quote: At 9:26 a.m., we succeeded in a manual switchover to Device 2 of NAS, which returned all functions back to normal.
supports: 9:26 a.m. manual switchover
all functions returned to normal

tse2020oct19exec.title: Report on the Cash Equity Trading System Failure on Oct. 1
tse2020oct19exec.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc.
tse2020oct19exec.quote: Although the network had been shut down, orders that were received before 8:54 a.m. had been matched and execution notifications had accumulated within arrowhead without being sent to trading participants.
supports: orders received before 8:54 a.m. had already matched inside arrowhead
execution notifications piled up unsent

tse2020oct19wholeday.title: Report on the Cash Equity Trading System Failure on Oct. 1
tse2020oct19wholeday.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc.
tse2020oct19wholeday.quote: As such, at 11:45 a.m., we decided to halt trading for the whole day and made an announcement of this decision.
supports: 11:45 a.m. whole-day halt announcement

tse2020oct19rules.title: Report on the Cash Equity Trading System Failure on Oct. 1
tse2020oct19rules.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc.
tse2020oct19rules.quote: As we had no agreement with trading participants on rebooting arrowhead, and had not carried out any tests, we judged that rebooting arrowhead to resume trading would be too risky to justify in our position as market operator. We recognize that there was an issue in our lack of rules on how to handle trade resumption after a trading halt in the event of a system failure.
supports: no agreement with trading participants on rebooting arrowhead
no tests of a reboot
lack of rules on trade resumption after a system-failure halt

tse2020oct05.title: The Cause of the Recent Failure in arrowhead and Measures Implemented
tse2020oct05.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc.
tse2020oct05.quote: We found that, among the switching functions for failures in the Device, automatic switching does not function for the case of a failure resulting from a memory module failure.
supports: automatic switching does not fire on a memory module failure
settings corrected into the system on October 4

jpx2020c38.title: 調査報告書 (Investigation Report on the System Failure)
jpx2020c38.author: システム障害に係る独立社外取締役による調査委員会 (Investigation Committee of Independent Outside Directors), for Japan Exchange Group, Inc.
jpx2020c38.quote: 取引再開した場合に注文を再発注することが可能と回答した参加者もあったものの、その売買代金シェアは約 38%にとどまるものであり、その属性も、外資系証券に限定される
jpx2020c38.quote_translation: Although some participants answered that they would be able to re-send orders if trading resumed, their share of trading value came to only about 38%, and they were limited to foreign-affiliated securities firms.
supports: about 38% of trading value could re-send orders
those firms were all foreign-affiliated brokers

jpx2020c50.title: 調査報告書 (Investigation Report on the System Failure)
jpx2020c50.author: システム障害に係る独立社外取締役による調査委員会 (Investigation Committee of Independent Outside Directors), for Japan Exchange Group, Inc.
jpx2020c50.quote: 結果として、当日の売買再開後に対応が可能な取引参加者について、コンティンジェンシー・プランに定める売買代金 50％のシェアを満たさない可能性が高い点や既に受け付けた注文の取扱いをはじめとして、総合的に勘案し、11 時から清田 JPX CEO、宮原東証代表取締役社長が出席して臨時リスク管理委員会を開催し、当該委員会における議論を踏まえ、終日売買停止とする旨、障害対策本部において宮原社長が決定した。
jpx2020c50.quote_translation: As a result, weighing among other things the high likelihood that the trading participants able to cope with a same-day resumption would not meet the 50% share of trading value set out in the contingency plan, and the handling of orders already accepted, an extraordinary Risk Management Committee was convened from 11:00 attended by JPX CEO Kiyota and TSE President Miyahara, and following its discussion President Miyahara decided at the failure response headquarters to halt trading for the whole day.
supports: the contingency plan's 50% trading-value share threshold
extraordinary Risk Management Committee from 11:00
TSE President Miyahara took the whole-day halt decision
JPX CEO Kiyota attended

jpx2020c2ways.title: 調査報告書 (Investigation Report on the System Failure)
jpx2020c2ways.author: システム障害に係る独立社外取締役による調査委員会 (Investigation Committee of Independent Outside Directors), for Japan Exchange Group, Inc.
jpx2020c2ways.quote: ①遮断されたネットワークをそのまま復旧させた場合には約定通知が取引参加者に送信されてしまうことになり、②他方で arrowhead を再立ち上げした上で取引再開する場合には、失効通知を受領せずに「発注済み」のままとなっている注文を再度発注するという特殊な対応が取引参加者に求められることとなり、①及び②のいずれの方策も実施することが困難であるという判断から、東証は終日売買停止とするという判断を行った。
jpx2020c2ways.quote_translation: (i) If the severed network were simply restored, execution notices would be sent to trading participants; (ii) on the other hand, if trading were resumed after rebooting arrowhead, participants would be required to take the unusual step of re-sending orders that remained 'already placed' because they had received no cancellation notice. Judging that neither (i) nor (ii) could be carried out, TSE decided to halt trading for the whole day.
supports: restoring the network would have delivered execution notices from a session that never opened
rebooting would have forced members to re-send orders they were never told were dead

tse2021council.title: Report from the Council for Recurrence Prevention Measures
tse2021council.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc.
tse2021council.quote: However, the main cause of TSE's failing to resume trading was an absence of rules and procedures for trading resumptions after a trading suspension resulting from a system failure.
supports: the absence of rules, not the hardware, is named as the main cause of not resuming
Council report dated 25 March 2021
measures to be implemented in April 2021

tse2021reboot.title: Trading resumption through a system reboot
tse2021reboot.author: Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. / Japan Exchange Group
tse2021reboot.quote: Orders received by TSE from trading participants will be cancelled when the system is rebooted. In these cases, trading participants will, in principle, need to resend entrusted orders received from customers to TSE.
supports: the post-2020 rule: a reboot cancels orders the exchange holds and members re-send
executions already processed normally stay valid

bloomberg2020.title: How Tokyo's $6 trillion stock market came to a halt due to one piece of hardware
bloomberg2020.author: Gearoid Reidy, Shoko Oda, Min Jeong Lee and Toshiro Hasegawa (Bloomberg), read via the ThePrint syndication
bloomberg2020.quote: It was less than an hour before the system, called Arrowhead, was due to start processing orders in the $6 trillion equity market. Exchange officials could see no solution. The full-day shutdown that ensued was the longest since the exchange switched to a fully electronic trading system in 1999.
supports: the market's size given as $6 trillion, in the article body as well as the headline
longest shutdown since the 1999 move to fully electronic trading
the romanisation 'Koichiro Miyahara' (the piece titles him TSE Chief Executive Officer; the JPX committee report has 宮原東証代表取締役社長, TSE Representative Director and President)

unverified: That Koichiro Miyahara resigned over the failure. JPX published a news release dated 30 November 2020 titled 'Retirement of Representative Executive Officer and Related Matters' and another titled 'Business Improvement Orders on System Failure and Clarification of Locus of Responsibility', but both pages render their bodies via JavaScript and returned no text, no PDF attachment and no Wayback snapshot. The resignation is therefore not claimed in the prose.

The date and contents of the Financial Services Agency's business improvement order to TSE and JPX. The allocation brief gives 27 November 2020; the JPX release announcing the orders carries 30 November 2020 in its URL. Neither the FSA English nor the FSA Japanese press-release page for those dates was located, so no date is claimed.
The count of roughly 3,700 listed issues halted. TSE's own report says only 'all listed issues'; no primary count for 1 October 2020 was opened.
Any figure for trading value or fee revenue lost on 1 October 2020. None of the TSE, JPX or Council documents opened quantifies it.

An English translation of the JPX Investigation Committee report (調査報告書, 30 November 2020) reportedly exists but no URL was located; the three passages cited here were read and matched character-for-character in the Japanese original, with translations stored alongside. Prefer the English PDF if it surfaces.
